avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces etravirine plasma concentrations below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with etravirine

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer decreases etravirine exposure by approximately 40%
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antimicrobial if possible

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 at high doses, potentially reducing etravirine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor virologic response; use moderate doses only

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 induction properties
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor etravirine efficacy

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Etravirine requires fasting state or low-fat meal for optimal absorption; fatty foods significantly decrease bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Take etravirine with a low-fat meal or on an empty stomach; avoid high-fat foods around dosing time

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase etravirine levels slightly
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects if regularly consumed

monitoring_notes: Monitor HIV RNA viral load and CD4 counts regularly to assess etravirine efficacy, particularly if potential interactions occur. Counsel patients on strict adherence to fasting/low-fat meal requirements and the critical importance of avoiding St. John's Wort.
